en.sub: One field — one thought. <kbd>N</kbd> — new capture, <kbd>T</kbd> — Today, <kbd>F</kbd> — focus, <kbd>E</kbd> — export
en.capture_ph: What's on your mind? Enter to save
en.search_ph: 🔍 Search all tasks and notes (archive included)…
en.dropzone: Drop a screenshot here (OCR, if Tesseract is installed)
en.ocr_fallback: OCR unavailable — type the text manually (drop a screenshot or enter it yourself)
en.rec_btn_title: Repeat: none → daily → weekly → weekdays → every N days
en.timer_title: Timer: start/stop (session history on the task)
en.done_title: Complete (recurring tasks spawn their next occurrence)
en.focus_alert: Focus is available for tasks in Today
en.stats_note: Minutes of closed focus sessions (pomodoro/timer) per day. A running timer counts once you stop it.
en.tour1_text: One field — one thought. Type and press Enter: the date (“tomorrow 15:00”), type and #tags are recognised automatically.
en.tour2_text: Sort into buckets: Inbox → Today → Week → Someday. On each task: ↻ repeat, ⏱ timer, ✓ complete.
en.tour3_text: Everything is stored locally. One-click export: JSON (key E), calendar (ICS) and Todoist/Markdown.
